title.narrative: Enhance well-being of children and other populations affected by humanitarian crisis in Borno through life saving integrated CP GBV response.

description.narrative: ltpgtCPPLI is proposing a 6 months project aimed at saving lives of crisis affected children and their families as well as women and girls survivors of gender-based violence and other vulnerable individual at risks through promoting their overall well-being by enhancing their positive coping mechanisms resilience and restoring sense of normalcy. The project is a multi-sectoral intervention focusing on integrated CP and GBV response to be implemented in Damboa for CP and GBV. Geographically, the project will be implemented in 1 LGAs of Borno state (Damboa) which are among the worst hit LGAs with the food insecurity in 2025 as described by the Cadre Harmonise analysis. The consequences of the food insecurity crisis had impacted negatively on the affected population especially children and their families as well as survivors of GBV and other vulnerable individual at risks. This project therefore intend to address these negative coping mechanisms, enhance resilience of the affected population to enable them adapt and bounce back to their normal life functioning. CPPLI is requesting a total of ltbgtUS$100,000 lt/bgtltbgt(US$75,000 from the CP AoR US$25,000 from the GBV AoR)lt/bgt to implement this project. The project will directly reach a total of 3,275 individuals with comprehensive CP GBV response services that meets best practices and global standards. Of these total numbers, 15% (502) are persons with disabilities, and 9,825 individuals are indirectly targeted. The targeting per sector are: CP- 2,115 are targeted under CP AoR while 1,160 are targeted under GBV. This targeting is strategic and had aligned closely with the priorities of both the GBV CP AoRs. ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtIn addition, the proposed project aimed to deliver on 4 complementary outcomes that surrounded CP GBV service provision. The outcomes are complementary and integrated and surrounded the strategic objectives of the 2 sectors as per below: ltbrgtltbgtltbrgtlt/bgtlt/pgtltpgtltbgtOutcome 1lt/bgt is a child protection outcome which aimed at ensuring that unaccompanied and separated children, including children who have suffered grave child rights violations such as CAAGs and other Children at risk ofltbrgtabuse, neglect, exploitation and violence including children with disabilities affected by humanitarian conflict accessed comprehensive case management services and enjoy adequate protection of their rights. ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtltbgtOutcome 2lt/bgt is also a child protection outcome which focused to ensured that conflict affected children and their caregivers and other members of the communities accessed quality mental health and psycho-social support and adopted positive behaviors and social norms that aimed at eliminating abuse, neglect, exploitation and violence against boys and girls.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtltbgtOutcome 3lt/bgt is a gender-based violence outcome which is complemented with CP and focused to ensure that survivors of GBV and other vulnerable individual at risks have improved access to quality lifesaving and well-coordinated GBV response services and have their wellbeing enhanced ltbrgtltbgtltbrgtlt/bgtlt/pgtltpgtltbgtOutcome 4lt/bgt of the project focused on both CP and GBV and aimed to strengthen institutional systems at both government and community levels through enhancing the government capacities and technical knowledge to be able to respond adequately to child protection and gender-based violence related issues through prevention, risk mitigation and response services that align with relevant standards. ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtCPPLI is strategically partnering with Yerwa Empowerment Foundation (YEF) to implement this project. YEF is positioned within the GBV AoR and have an overarching presence in Damboa and presently implementing similar activities in the LGA. YEF will implement the GBV component of this project while receiving direct support and coaching from CPPLI. Both CPPLI YEF have presence in the targeted communities of intervention and is well rooted and networked within the targeted communities thereby guaranteeing effective and efficient implementation of the project. ltbrgtlt/pgt
